ratings_why.fun: Every tier has a clear job and the growth climbs nicely, from Mute and Apprentice to Inkcap's fuse to Bellows' sell turns to Sprout chains in the late game.
ratings_why.distinct: Folding sales into deaths is fresh, but Fruit itself plays like a familiar 'when this dies, summon a token' tribe.

verdict_why: The Stinkhorn sell loop is unbounded and the Sprout's X needs one clear rule; both are real fixes.

points.text: A Sprout beside Stinkhorn, Herald has Fruit, so selling it leaves a new Sprout in the same slot, which also has Fruit. You can sell it for free forever while recruiting: the Sprout's X and the Register climb with no limit. Make Stinkhorn's aura skip Sprouts, or work in fights only.
Is a Sprout's X fixed when it is summoned, or does it keep counting? And what is a shop Sprout's size in the next fight, when 'this turn' is over? State it on the card.
Sprouts add no hero damage, so a Procession board wins fights but hits for little. A late card that lets Sprouts count as having started the fight would make the build close out games.

Black-Gloved Undertaker kills early, when the Sprout is only 1/1. Letting it kill at Start of Combat after other Start of Combat effects, or giving its victim's Sprout +X, would make it less of a trap.
Grandmother Bootlace is the only Register reader. One more mid-tier card that reads it would give the across-the-game count a shape before Tier 6.

standouts.why: Clerk Inkcap is a buffer that is also a fuse; Health buffs become fuel, a nice skill test.
Bootlace Cordwainer is a clean Tier 4 multiplier that doubles every slot refill.
Bellows Puffwell turns a sell turn into a big permanent board buff; a clear direction card.

weakest.why: Black-Gloved Undertaker usually trades a body for a 1/1 Sprout early in the fight.
Funeral Steward is plain economy with nothing Guild-shaped about it.
Hired Mute only grows Attack, so it folds to any trade by mid-game.

flags.note: Stinkhorn plus any Sprout beside it: free infinite sells while recruiting, unbounded Sprout size and Register.
Grandmother Bootlace grows off the Register, which a sell-heavy shop pumps fast, even with the Stinkhorn loop closed.
Candlesnuff Abbess with Bootlace Cordwainer doubles each refill; six times a fight bounds it, but golden twelve with golden Cordwainer is a lot.
Sprout X: fixed at summon or live, and what a shop Sprout's size is next fight.
